best: Power paths are drawn as real left-to-right wired paths (3V3 buck, 5 V buck, four-switch stage with sense resistors and cap banks in line, protection FET chain) under clear section titles.
worst: Text collisions around the gauge IC and charger gate resistors: C105/R105 values, TH101/R113/PACK_P label, R115/R116 over the SCL label, R445/R446 over HG2, Q102 value over R111, J116/J120 captions run together.
Many parts float alone tied only by labels (D101, D401 TVS, U402 EEPROM, Q409, Q103, R432, NTC connectors, separate decoupling-cap groups) so their role must be found by net-name search.

Unbalanced page use: MCU and 3V3 sheets are more than half empty, the Cells sheet leaves the bottom third blank, while pin stubs and labels at the ICs are cramped; charger sheet has long parallel wire bundles to follow.
